name: Heiligenstadt no Uta
original_name: ハイリゲンシュタットの歌
source:
Lied, an orphan whose parents supposedly died in an accident, has recently began to live on her own (with her cockatiel Soprano who can talk due to all the magic of her town of Shall). She is also a pianist for her former orphanage but she’s not really that good. Actually she really sucks at both playing piano and cooking. One day she meets a bunch of dudes who happen to have the magical “Falga” powers of famous classical pianists. An evil force called the Forgotten Apostle comes and tries to steal all the sound from the town because of the “evil noise” that’s coming from the darkness inside the performers. Most average people are affected but Lied is safe – so now she joins the musical academy to work with everyone to help restore music back to Shall and defeat the Forgotten Apostle.

[From [url=https://breadmasterlee.com/2018/05/17/otome-game-review-heiligenstadt-lied/#more-22320]Hinano's blog[/url]]
translation:
Lied是一名孤兒，據說她的父母死於一場事故。最近，她開始獨自生活，身邊只有一隻會說話的玄鳳鸚鵡Soprano——這得歸功於她所在的Shall鎮的魔法。她還在曾經的孤兒院擔任鋼琴師，但其實她琴彈得不怎麼樣，廚藝也好不到哪裡去。

某天，她遇見了一群擁有「Falga」魔法力量的男人。這種力量來自著名古典音樂家。名為「忘卻的使徒」的邪惡力量降臨，試圖奪走城鎮的所有聲音，因為演奏者心中的黑暗正在製造「邪惡的噪音」。大多數普通人都受到影響，只有Lied安然無恙。於是，她加入音樂學院，與所有人一起恢復Shall的音樂，並擊敗忘卻的使徒。

（來源：[url=https://breadmasterlee.com/2018/05/17/otome-game-review-heiligenstadt-lied/#more-22320]Hinano的部落格[/url]）
